def expect(label, fn):
    try:
        fn(); print('NO-RAISE', label)
    except ValueError as e: print('RAISED  ', label, '::', str(e)[:70])
    except TypeError as e: print('TYPEERR ', label, '::', str(e)[:70])

# 1 extra z key
p=copy.deepcopy(orig); p['regions'][0]['z_min_m']=-.3; t.plan=p; t.sign(); expect('extra z bound', lambda: t.observe())
# 2 duplicate frame_group
p=copy.deepcopy(orig); p['regions'][1]['frame_group']=p['regions'][0]['frame_group']; t.plan=p; t.sign(); expect('dup frame_group', lambda: t.observe())
# 3 two fits
p=copy.deepcopy(orig); p['regions'][1]['role']='fit'; t.plan=p; t.sign(); expect('two FIT roles', lambda: t.observe())
# 4 zero fits
p=copy.deepcopy(orig); p['regions'][0]['role']='validation'; t.plan=p; t.sign(); expect('zero FIT roles', lambda: t.observe())
# restore
t.plan=copy.deepcopy(orig); t.sign()
obs,rows=t.observe()
def sel():
    s=t.confirmed(obs); return s
# 5 empty indices in a validation region

expect('caller-modified observation binding', lambda: validate_confirmed_rows(s2,o2,t.points,t.manifest,{'fixture':{'path':'fixture','sha256':'ab'*32}},t.model,t.plan))
# 7 fit slot uses a validation region id

expect('fit uses validation region id', lambda: validate_confirmed_rows(s3,obs,t.points,t.manifest,{'fixture':{'path':'fixture','sha256':'ab'*32}},t.model,t.plan))
# 8 missing one validation region

expect('missing validation region', lambda: validate_confirmed_rows(s4,obs,t.points,t.manifest,{'fixture':{'path':'fixture','sha256':'ab'*32}},t.model,t.plan))
# 9 valid positive still passes
